CREATE TABLE "attentions" (
	"attentionId" integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"activityId" integer,
	"speciality" varchar(255),
	"timestamp" timestamp with time zone,
	"activityStatus" varchar(100),
	"activityType" varchar(100),
	"alliedOrganization" varchar(255),
	"patientId" varchar(255),
	"patientSex" varchar(1),
	"patientAge" integer,
	"patientDocumentType" varchar(100),
	"patientInsuranceType" varchar(100),
	"activityName" varchar(255),
	"activityDate" timestamp with time zone,
	"activityRegistrations" integer,
	"activityRewarded" integer,
	"activityNewParticipants" integer,
	"activityRegion" varchar(100)
);
